mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) as a bowel preparation agent may reduce intestinal transit time and decrease B12 absorption in the terminal ileum by limiting contact time with intrinsic factor-bound B12.
action: Separate administration of vitamin B12 supplementation from PEG bowel preparation by at least 2 weeks, particularly in patients with borderline B12 levels or those dependent on oral B12 supplementation.
